sections.heading: Core Gameplay Mechanics
sections.body:
At its core, 'Ouija Voices' is a puzzle game that requires you to solve a series of increasingly complex puzzles to progress through levels. The game's core mechanics involve using your mouse, keyboard, or touch controls to manipulate a series of letters and symbols on a Ouija board. Your goal is to spell out words, phrases, or numbers by moving the planchette (a small heart-shaped piece) to the corresponding letters on the board.

The game's mechanics are deceptively simple, but mastering the puzzles requires a combination of critical thinking, pattern recognition, and strategic planning. As you progress through levels, you'll encounter increasingly complex puzzles that will challenge your skills and push you to think outside the box.
